name: logo-com
description: Create a logo, get brand basics (colors, fonts), or make a logo for a website. Browse your LOGO.com logos and generate up to four new designs from a business name and ideas. Use when someone wants to create a logo, design a logo, make a logo, use a logo maker, get a brand mark with colors and fonts, or get a logo for their website. Requires a LOGO.com premium plan; generation uses AI credits.

interface.shortDescription: Create a logo, logo maker, brand mark, logo for website
interface.longDescription:
Create a logo and brand basics (colors, fonts), then continue on logo.com for brand kit or a website — from chat.

Connect your LOGO.com account to generate up to four new logo designs from a business name and ideas, list recent logos with previews and editor links, or open one to see its colors, fonts and download files. New designs are drafts until you open one in the LOGO.com editor and save it. After saving, brand kit and website tools are available on logo.com; this plugin covers logo creation and browsing account logos.

Natural intents: create a logo, design a logo, make a logo, logo maker, brand mark, logo colors and fonts, logo for my business, logo for my website.

Requirements: a LOGO.com premium plan. Creating designs uses your account's AI credits.
